svg.title: Deposit flow through the Cross-Chain Vault Adapter
svg.desc: Numbered steps of a deposit. 1: on the source chain, the user sends the asset and the payload to the adapter through the CCIP Router. 2: CCIP verifies and delivers the message; on CCIP 2.0 lanes the verifier and finality policy are checked first. On the hub chain, in one transaction: 3: the adapter validates the source chain, the token count, and the 128-byte payload. 4: the asset was received, so the request is a deposit; the vault must be allowlisted, the amount above zero, and deposits enabled. 5: only when returning, the adapter fee is deducted from the asset. 6: the adapter deposits into the vault and receives the shares. 7: the adapter checks that the shares are above zero and at least minimumOut. 8a: local delivery of the shares to the beneficiary on the hub chain. 8b, dashed: the adapter sends the shares back over CCIP and pays the CCIP fee in the native gas token. 9, dashed: the beneficiary receives the shares through a second, later CCIP message on the same source chain; the diagram shows one source-chain region holding both step 1 and step 9, because a return goes only to the chain the request came from.

g.text: Source chain
1. User sends the asset and the payload
One CCIP message to the adapter
through the CCIP Router
2. CCIP verifies and delivers the message
CCIP 2.0 lanes: verifier and finality policy checked first
Hub chain (one transaction)
3. Adapter validates the message
Source chain configured, exactly one token, 128-byte payload
4. Asset received, so the request is a deposit
Vault allowlisted, amount above zero, deposits enabled
5. Adapter fee deducted (return only)
Flat fee in asset units, taken before the deposit
6. Adapter deposits into the vault
vault.deposit(amount, adapter): the adapter receives the shares
7. Adapter checks the output
Shares above zero and at least minimumOut
8a. Local delivery
Shares sent to the beneficiary on this chain
8b. Return to the source chain
Adapter pays the CCIP fee in the native gas token
9. Beneficiary receives the shares
Delivered by a second CCIP message
Dashed: only when the payload requests return to the source chain
